structural_finding.reason: The forward-causal smoke is selecting almost entirely inactive tail contracts: 39/41 logged signal candidates had zero token trades anywhere in the recorder's full 900-second tape, and all 8 actually posted tokens had zero trades. In addition, the maker sizes many orders at approximately 25% of displayed bid touch before applying a queue-ahead multiple gate. For non-cash-binding orders this mechanically makes queue_ahead / own_shares approximately 4, so a max_queue_multiple=6 gate can admit large dead queues even when observed causal contra-flow hazard is zero. Liquidity and static edge are therefore not valid substitutes for short-horizon fill activity.
structural_finding.required_challenger: Apply a causal activity/fill-hazard screen before reserving maker capital, rank positive-flow candidates by post-cost edge times a conservative fill-capacity proxy, cancel/recycle dead queues, and allow inside-spread improvement only when incremental price cost is paid by post-cost edge. Do not convert to taker solely to manufacture fills.
